summary: Tested Tournament Bracket Builder UI redesign (P0 feature). Admin bracket builder works correctly with horizontal layout, match cards, connector lines, champion badge, floating action bar on hover, tab switching (Bracket/Games List), Add Team modal, and score editing. Public TournamentPage exists but is NOT navigable (not wired to any route).

integration_issues.issue: TournamentPage component is imported in App.js (line 7) but NOT rendered - no case in switch statement and no route to access it. Users cannot view tournament brackets as spectators.

issues: Both round columns show 'FINAL' label - should show 'FINAL' only for the last round (Semifinals/Quarterfinals for earlier rounds)
0 Teams displayed in header but 4 teams are in the bracket

action_items: MEDIUM: Wire TournamentPage to navigation - add case 'tournaments' in App.js switch statement to render TournamentPage
MINOR: Fix round naming - first round shows 'FINAL' but should show round-appropriate name based on totalRounds
MINOR: Fix team count display - shows '0 Teams' but bracket has 4 teams
critical_code_review_comments: TournamentBracketBuilder.js line 79: getRoundName function is called during generateBracket but rounds.length is used before rounds array is complete
TournamentBracketBuilder.js line 567: Team count displays bracketData.teams.length but this may not reflect actual teams in bracket
App.js: TournamentPage imported but never rendered - dead import

success_rate.frontend: 90% - All admin bracket builder features work. Public tournament page not accessible.

test_credentials: Admin user via localStorage: mlbl_current_user with roles=['admin','coach']
